dashboardQueries.name: 8e65f3e0-2057-4c55-acf9-54a4408d3453
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "asset_classification" 
$brand=if(about.user.company_name!="", about.user.company_name, "Unknown")
principal.mac!=""
match:
    $brand
outcome:
    $count=count_distinct(principal.mac)
order:
    $count desc 
limit:
    10

dashboardQueries.name: db7fd679-3048-4803-86d3-6cd215981240
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "asset_classification"
$date_hour=timestamp.get_timestamp(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, "%Y-%m-%d : %H")
$confidence = if(about.security_result.confidence_score>=40, "High", if(about.security_result.confidence_score>=20, "Medium", if(about.security_result.confidence_score>=1, "Low", "Unknown")))
match:
    $date_hour, principal.ip, $confidence
outcome:
    $mac=array_distinct(if(principal.mac!="", principal.mac, "Unknown"))
    $os_name=array_distinct(if(about.asset.attribute.labels.value!="", about.asset.attribute.labels.value, "Unknown"))
    $os_ver=array_distinct(if(about.platform_version!="", about.platform_version, "Unknown"))
    $type_name=array_distinct(if(about.resource.resource_subtype!="", about.resource.resource_subtype, "Unknown"))
    $type_group=array_distinct(if(about.group.group_display_name!="", about.group.group_display_name, "Unknown"))
    $brand=array_distinct(if(about.user.company_name!="", about.user.company_name, "Unknown"))
    $model=array_distinct(if(about.asset.hardware.model!="", about.asset.hardware.model, "Unknown"))
    $sources=array_distinct(if(about.ip_geo_artifact.tags!="", about.ip_geo_artifact.tags, "Unknown"))
limit:
    100

dashboardQueries.name: 9c6004b5-ac70-4139-a712-d9352841acf5

dashboardQueries.name: b4be77ad-bd54-4155-812a-9908cc74e2b6
dashboardQueries.query:

metadata.product_event_type = "asset_classification"

$device_type=if(about.asset.category!="", about.asset.category, "Unknown")

$model=if(about.asset.hardware.model!="", about.asset.hardware.model, "Unknown")

match:
    $device_type, $brand, $model
outcome:
    $count=count_distinct(principal.ip)
order:
    $count desc
limit:
    100
